resume.title: User Resume
resume.description: Stores user resume information, personal details, and work experience

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this resume

title.description: Title or applicant name of the resume

photoUploadedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the personal photo was uploaded

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the resume was first created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the resume was last updated

/resumes/{resumeId}.description: Collection of resumes created by users
